message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Mitchell Stoltz, who works as a Senior Staff Attorney at the Electronic Frontier Foundation, wrote a formal letter to GitHub. This message was sent on behalf of the youtube-dl maintainers. They are asking the code-sharing platform to restore public access to the tool. The letter argues that the software's unit tests qualify as fair use and do not break copyright rules. It urges GitHub to undo its choice to block the repository. That block happened after the Recording Industry Association of America sent a takedown notice under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act."}
